following the 2024 launch of the church’s child safeguarding policy, ailish higgins, our diocesan director of safeguarding met with young people from the diocese to ask them “what does a safe & welcoming church mean to you?” thanks to all the children and young people who took part in these sessions and were open and honest about their experience of parish life. thanks too to their parents, the group leaders and parish priests who supported the facilitation of these groups. national board for safeguarding children in the catholic church in ireland – biannual conference the held their biannual conference from 3rd – 5th september 2025 titled: towards a restorative and transitional justice model of engaging with victims and survivors in the catholic church in ireland. the event aimed to enhance the understanding we all have of how we must engage in a just and restorative way with those who have suffered harm in the catholic church in ireland. our diocesan director of safeguarding and dlp attended the event and shared valuable feedback with our diocesan safeguarding committee. the learning from the conference will help guide our practice going forward. special thanks to the national board for organising and hosting the event. youth participation amadeus christmas clane confirmation class safeguarding checklist for parishes displayed in all church porches the kildare & sacred music workshop day for parish choirs – calling all choir members! bishop denis and the commission for liturgical formation are hosting a worksho p day for choir members in the diocese on saturday, 21 november 2026 from 11 am-4:30pm in carlow cathedral. led by marian gaynor and team, this promises to be a lovely day for choir members with a guide for music ministry, a hot lunch and a big sing of liam lawton’s ‘magnifi cat’ all included. the day is free of charge, but places are limited and registration is essential. musi c pack and lunch can only be provided for choir members from the diocese who have booked a place. bookings open on monday 19th october.
